تتراشقوا (form VI)
# تَتَرَاشَقُوا (tatarāšaqū) /ta.ta.raː.ʃa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تُتَرَاشَقُوا (tutarāšaqū) /tu.ta.raː.ʃa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
